channel.title: ALTRENDAT
channel.description: What the world is searching for, explained with sources

item.title: Achraf Hakimi stars as Morocco routs Niger with emphatic 5-1 victory
item.description: Morocco extended its home winning streak to 16 matches by defeating Niger 5-1 in the Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers on Friday.

item.title: Orange Level 5 warning triggers flood alert across three South African provinces
item.description: The South African Weather Service issued an Orange Level 5 warning for severe thunderstorms, flooding, and damaging winds affecting multiple provinces this Saturday and Sunday.

item.title: Super Eagles Seek Crucial AFCON Redemption Against Tanzania in Uyo Home Clash
item.description: Nigeria targets a critical Group L victory against Tanzania this Friday following a recent 3-0 defeat to Guinea-Bissau.

item.title: World Series Champion Jake Bauers Snaps Up Four-Year Deal With Red Sox
item.description: Slugger Jake Bauers signed a four-year, $58 million contract with the Boston Red Sox after declining a qualifying offer from the Milwaukee Brewers.

item.title: Devin Booker Snatches Win Against Hornets While Climbing All-Time Scoring List
item.description: Devin Booker scored 30 points to lead the Phoenix Suns to a 101-96 victory over the Charlotte Hornets on Thursday.

item.title: Commanders Quarterback Sam Hartman Swaps The Football Field For The Bachelor Mansion
item.description: Washington Commanders practice squad quarterback Sam Hartman will star in the 30th season of ABC's The Bachelor, premiering on March 21, 2027.

item.title: Antoine Dupont switches to flyhalf for France in showdown against Springboks
item.description: France fields star scrumhalf Antoine Dupont at flyhalf for Friday's Nations Championship match against South Africa at the Stade de France.

item.title: Pio Esposito brace inspires Italy to storm past France at San Siro
item.description: Italy climbed to the top of Nations League Group A1 after a 3-1 comeback victory over France in Milan.

item.title: Google Launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Replacing 3.8 Flash With Triple Speed
item.description: Google has officially released Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a faster, more efficient AI model replacing the 3.8 Flash version across its products.

item.title: Spain extends winning streak to 12 matches after routing 10-man Czech Republic
item.description: Spain defeated the 10-man Czech Republic 2-0 in the UEFA Nations League, maintaining their unbeaten run in 43 matches.

item.title: Global Microsoft Outage Disables Outlook and Teams Across 74 Different Countries
item.description: Microsoft services including Outlook and Teams faced a global disruption impacting users in 74 countries for over 12 hours starting Thursday.

item.title: Matt Henry’s triple-wicket maiden sparks New Zealand’s massive 244-run rout of India
item.description: Matt Henry took 6-27 to bowl India out for 89 after Will Young’s 125 propelled New Zealand to a 333-run total at Bay Oval.

item.title: London Firms Charge £100,000 for Fraudulent UK Global Talent Visa Packages
item.description: An undercover BBC investigation revealed consultancy firms are creating fake art portfolios and fabricated credentials to help wealthy migrants secure UK visas.

item.title: Matt Henry rips through India with six wickets in massive 244-run win
item.description: Matt Henry claimed six wickets to bowl India out for 89, securing a 244-run victory for New Zealand in the fourth ODI on Friday.

item.title: Tornadoes strike Delaware and New Jersey as snow chances arrive Friday morning
item.description: Tornadoes touched down in New Castle County and Burlington County on Thursday, Nov. 12, following severe storms across the Philadelphia region.

item.title: Australia Hosts England in Perth for Opening One Day International Cricket Clash
item.description: Australia and England meet at Optus Stadium in Perth for the first of three one-day international cricket matches.

item.title: Record-breaker Harry Kane strikes late as England topples Croatia 2-1
item.description: England captain Harry Kane netted his 92nd international goal to seal a 2-1 Nations League victory against Croatia at Wembley.

item.title: Harry Kane nets winner as he becomes England's most capped player
item.description: Harry Kane secured a victory over Croatia with a penalty goal while officially breaking the record for the most appearances for England.

item.title: Defense Secretary Hegseth Awards Medal to Guard Who Silenced His Group
item.description: Pete Hegseth presented the Joint Service Commendation Medal to Specialist Thomas Iglesias after the soldier corrected the secretary’s behavior at Arlington National Cemetery.

item.title: World champion Spain visits winless Czech Republic in Nations League clash
item.description: Spain travels to the epet ARENA in Prague this Thursday, November 12, to face the Czech Republic in the Nations League Group A3.

item.title: Barcelona Duo Pau Cubarsi and Fermin Lopez Start for Spain in Prague
item.description: Manager Luis de la Fuente has confirmed his starting lineup for Spain’s UEFA Nations League match against Czechia.

item.title: Choco Mucho Breaks Seven-Game Losing Streak Against Creamline in Five-Set Thriller
item.description: The Choco Mucho Flying Titans defeated the Creamline Cool Smashers 23-25, 25-13, 25-23, 22-25, 15-13 on Thursday night at the Smart Araneta Coliseum.

item.title: Stephen Curry Exits Early With Abdominal Soreness as Warriors Streak Snaps
item.description: Stephen Curry left Wednesday's loss to the Houston Rockets after five minutes due to right abdominal soreness.

item.title: Optimum restores internet service after massive third-party infrastructure damage across West Virginia
item.description: Optimum restored internet services on November 11, 2026, after a third-party line cut caused widespread outages throughout West Virginia and parts of Ohio.

item.title: Severe Storms Bring Damaging Wind, Hail and Isolated Tornado Risk Thursday
item.description: Severe thunderstorms carrying risks of hail, damaging wind and isolated tornadoes are forecast for Philadelphia and South-Central Pennsylvania on Thursday.

item.title: Outlook outage hits 59,000 users across the Americas on Thursday morning
item.description: Microsoft is investigating reports of users unable to access Exchange Online mailboxes through multiple connection methods.

item.title: Barcelona targets Champions League dominance as Arsenal seeks another historic European shock
item.description: Reigning champions Barcelona host Arsenal at the Nou Camp this Thursday with a 100% record in the Women's Champions League group phase.

item.title: Kennedy Center Switches to Ticketmaster Amidst Former President's Live Nation Board Role
item.description: The Kennedy Center is moving to Ticketmaster for ticketing, sparking conflict of interest concerns as its former president served on the parent company's board during negotiations.

item.title: Winless Turkey faces relegation as Belgium arrives for must-win Nations League clash
item.description: Turkey hosts Belgium at Gursel Aksel Stadium on Thursday in a critical UEFA Nations League match as the hosts fight to avoid relegation.

item.title: Colette Kress takes charge as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns immediately
item.description: Nvidia CFO Colette Kress has been appointed interim CEO following the immediate resignation of Jensen Huang.

item.title: Manchester United Sacks Michael Carrick Following Worst Ever Premier League Season Start
item.description: Manchester United has sacked head coach Michael Carrick after he oversaw only one win in 10 matches, leaving the club in the relegation zone.

item.title: Over 700 Scottish schools hit by hoax bomb threats targeting students
item.description: More than 700 schools in Scotland and Northern Ireland received bomb threats that authorities have assessed as non-credible hoaxes.

item.title: System crash forces 40,000 students to abandon digital NCEA English exam
item.description: A major technical outage hit the NCEA Level 2 English exam across New Zealand this morning, forcing students to switch to paper or accept derived grades.

item.title: Knicks host Cavaliers as Cleveland seeks revenge for recent 109-97 home defeat
item.description: The Cleveland Cavaliers face the New York Knicks at Madison Square Garden on Wednesday night in an Eastern Conference rematch.

item.title: Singapore Airlines defends controversial business class seats after viral dental chair comparisons
item.description: Singapore Airlines addressed public criticism regarding its new business class cabin color palette following the November 6 unveiling of a $1.6 billion fleet revamp.

item.title: Dublin Pizza Max shuttered after discovery of extensive active rodent infestation
item.description: Health officials ordered the immediate closure of Pizza Max on Talbot Street after finding rodent droppings in food preparation areas.

item.title: Over 7,000 Schools Across Europe Hit by Wave of Bomb Hoaxes
item.description: More than 6,300 Italian schools and over 700 across Scotland and Northern Ireland received bomb threats that authorities have labeled as not credible.

item.title: Ultra Lotto jackpot hits P512 million as no ticket matches winning numbers
item.description: The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office announced that no bettors matched the winning combination of 56-41-37-23-18-14 for the November 10, 2026 draw.

item.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Smashes Microsoft Store Records Ahead of November Launch
item.description: Grand Theft Auto VI launches on consoles and via XBOX Cloud Gaming on November 19, following record-breaking pre-order numbers.

item.title: Irish unions suspend nationwide public sector strike after securing major pay deal
item.description: Trade unions have called off a nationwide strike planned for November 12 after reaching a new 10.75% pay agreement with the government.
